results.title: There is work we need to do to introduce Bediuzzaman
results.description: Responding to questions from Yeni Asya, British journalist, author, and activist Lauren Booth said, "I have not yet understood (Said Nursi's) works. This means there is work we need to do to explain Bediuzzaman."

results.title: How a committee addressing Yale’s ties to slavery faded from public view
results.description: The committee worked slowly in its early stages, and few of its recommendations — which were never published — were acted on. Members speculated that President Donald Trump’s crackdown on diversity initiatives led to Yale’s hushed tone about their work.
